locations.label: Grand Staircase Artifact
locations.description: Reach the Grand Staircase and activate the Sentinel Artifact. Look for a vase emitting colored particles in each of the three stone groups. Break that vase, then kill four zombies close to the exposed stone. Interact with the charged stone and identify its vision. The color tells you where to search for the stone, not which task it will assign. Purple: Bedroom Hallway table; foot of the Master Bedroom bed; Trophy Room table near its fireplace. Green: Library table by the Mystery Box; Library near the silver-bullet bench; Study central table. Blue: Wine Cellar near the silver-melting bench; Wine Cellar table by the MX9. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Ballistic Shield bench
locations.description: Collect one piece from each shield group and assemble the Ballistic Shield in the Smoking Room. Keep it intact: the Library upgrade, blue-flame runs and telescope all need it. Base: Grand Staircase pillar near the Artifact; East Balcony beside Saug; West Balcony below stained glass. Window: Library sofa beside Trebuchet; floor by the opposite broken Library shelf; Study table upstairs. Gun assembly: East Hallway chair; Dining Room floor beside Swordfish; Dining Room ledge next to the bedroom stairs. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Silver melting bench
locations.description: Gather three silver objects and three gunpowder ingredients. Melt the silver objects at the Wine Cellar bench, then craft silver bullets at the Library bench. Equip them on your ordinary damage weapon and rebuy ammunition there when needed. Candlestick: Entrance Hall round table; floor beside Billiards fireplace; Main Hall near Mozu/clock. Trophy/vase: West Hallway beside the sofa; Dining Room side table opposite clock; corner of the long dining table. Plate: Wine Cellar wall near MX9; shelf opposite the bench; large table near the noose. Guano: tree right of Mausoleum; bottom of its left stairs; Cemetery corner between the approach paths. Charcoal: Billiards, Main Hall or Master Bedroom fireplace. Sulfur: left or right of Greenhouse Laboratory entrance; rear Laboratory table near ICR-7. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Alistair’s Folly case
locations.description: Find one glowing glyph in each color group. Save its shape in the visual helper, then set the Library lock’s blue, green, yellow and red dials to your observations. Interact with the case above the dials to submit and take Alistair’s Folly. The free case is the recommended route; a Mystery Box Folly can enter the same upgrade path. Blue: gravestone behind the tree near the Stake bench; grave right of Mausoleum stairs; front/top of the small crypt right of Mausoleum; lion-statue base. Green: gate left of Greenhouse entrance; inside Gardens gazebo; building beyond gate left of the Gardens perk; wall beyond gate right of the perk. Yellow: Forest Terrace wall left of Bowie Knife; outside left gate near GKS; outside right gate near Bowie; wall right of GKS. Red: wall right of Master Bedroom fireplace; East Gallery above the little table; Wine Cellar barrel behind the barrier near MX9; Dining Room above the bar painting. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Materia processing machine
locations.description: Kill a werewolf with a silver-bullet weapon and collect its Chaos Materia. Put it into the Greenhouse Laboratory processing machine and collect the Prima Materia from the other side. In Library, shield-bash the bookcase at the back-left of the Folly case, beside the silver-bullet table, and collect the blue gun part. Use the upgrade bench left of the Laboratory stairs to craft Chaos Theory. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Forest gate
locations.description: Once all three forks are collected, interact with the blocked Forest Terrace gate. Opening it summons a werewolf; the Pack-a-Punch machine is at the far end of the forest. Recommended: finish the silver-bullet recipe below before opening the gate so this werewolf supplies your first upgrade material. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Cemetery Path Stake bench
locations.description: Buy Bowie Knife at Forest Terrace. On the separate marked tree left of the lantern tree, Bowie-melee the same four shapes in the same order. Then shield-bash its symbols until a branch drops. Put the branch on the Mausoleum stone and kill vampires nearby until it stops taking souls and smokes orange. Pick it up and craft the Stake Knife at the Cemetery Path bench. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.
